rows.en:
(Luis-san...
I don't know what's troubling you,
but I believe...)
rows.notes: Inner monologue continues in c08555 (object of 'shinjitemasu'); cut at the matching point.

rows.en:
(...that you'll show me that lively,
passion-filled side of you again...)
rows.notes: Shared by the male and female scenes.

rows.en:
(The last time I ran into Luis-san here,
he seemed really down, but...)

I know I can't keep moping around forever!
I know that, but...

(Luis-san...
I don't know what's troubling you,
but I believe...)

(Okay, school's over.
Where should I stop by on the way home today...)
(Huh? I think someone's in the pool...)
Yo, Fresh Boy!

W-wait, Luis-san?!
Why are you in the school pool?

You ask me "why," but the reason is simple.
I was waiting for you to show up!
Fresh Boy!
You were waiting for me...?

Truth is, I came here to throw down
the gauntlet to you!

Here and now...
I challenge you to a swimming showdown
with Luis Fernando!
rows.notes: Luis names himself in full, as in the Japanese.

rows.en: Huh?! A showdown?!

Why do I have to go up against you,
Luis-san?

I'll tell you that if you can beat me,
Fresh Boy.

Is that so...
Then I can't afford to lose!

Oh, you've got a good look in your eyes now.
That fierce glint... I can't get enough of it.

(All right! I don't really get it, but
I'm definitely gonna beat Luis-san!)
You ready?
Yes, I'm ready anytime.

Here we go...
On your marks......
Get set...!
Hey! What do you two think you're doing here?
rows.notes: Hilda addresses Luis and the player (omaetachi).

rows.en: Huh?! Hilda-sensei!!
What do we do, Luis-san?
...Wait, he's already gone?!
rows.notes: He = Luis, in both scene variants.

rows.en:
That's so mean, Luis-san...
Running off and leaving me behind...

"Of the thirty-six stratagems, running away
is the best," as they say.
rows.notes: Proverb sanjuuroku-kei nigeru ni shikazu, kept with its stratagem image.

rows.en:
Hilda-sensei chewed me out like crazy,
you know!

Getting scolded is just love in disguise.
It'll make a good memory, too.
I really don't see it that way...

Anyway, the contest got called off,
but why did you need to have a contest
with me in the first place?

Heh, it's nothin'...
It was just a push to help me
shake off my past...
Shake off your past?

If I stay stuck in the past forever,
that guy's gonna laugh at me...
rows.notes: 'That guy' (aitsu) = Luis's late friend, revealed in frd_lis_008.

rows.en:
That's all. I just finally realized
something that simple.
Luis-san...?

Don't you worry about it.
This is my problem.

Your passion today...
wasn't half bad.

(Luis-san looked like a weight had been lifted...
Does that mean his troubles are over?)

(Hmm... That's a good thing, but
why a swimming showdown, of all things?)

(Well, it's Luis-san. There probably
wasn't any real meaning behind it.)
Yo, Fresh Girl!

You ask me "why," but the reason is simple.
I was waiting for you to show up!
Fresh Girl!
You were waiting for me...?

Why do I have to go up against you,
Luis-san?

I'll tell you that if you can beat me,
Fresh Girl.

(All right! I don't really get it, but
I'm definitely going to beat Luis-san!)

Anyway, the contest got called off,
but why did you need to have a contest
with me in the first place?

If I stay stuck in the past forever,
that guy's gonna laugh at me...

(Hmm... That's a good thing, but
why a swimming showdown, I wonder?)

(Well, it's Luis-san. I'm sure there
wasn't any real meaning behind it.)

(Okay, where should I stop by
on the way home today...)

Yo, Fresh Boy!
You're giving off some good passion today, too!
Oh, Luis-san. Hello.
...Wait!
Why are you in a swimsuit?!

Well, our showdown got interrupted
by Hilda the other day, right?

So I was waiting at the pool to challenge you
to a rematch, but Hilda caught me again
and kicked me out. That's the story.

(Even so, that doesn't seem like a reason
to still be in a swimsuit...)

Oops, it's almost time for my gig.
I'll take my leave for today,
Fresh Boy.
Oh, okay. See you...
(Luis-san went off still in his swimsuit...)

(He could get arrested for that.
Will he be okay...?)

(Okay, where should I stop by
on the way home today...)

Yo, Fresh Girl!
You're giving off some good passion today, too!

Oops, it's almost time for my gig.
I'll take my leave for today,
Fresh Girl.
(Luis-san went off still in his swimsuit...)

(He could get arrested for that.
Will he be okay...?)

uncertain: c08589/c08604: 'aitsu' = Luis's late friend from frd_lis_008; rendered 'that guy' (Luis calls him like a little brother there).
c08582: proverb 'of the thirty-six stratagems, running away is best' kept as a quoted saying rather than an English equivalent.
